title: Hezekiah shows the Babylonian envoys everything in his treasury
description: Berodach-Baladan, king of Babylon, sends letters and gifts to Hezekiah after his illness. Hezekiah shows the envoys his entire treasury and everything in his kingdom. The prophet Isaiah comes and proclaims that all will be carried off to Babylon, and that some of Hezekiah's descendants will become officials there.
